# Initialize Thunderbird Glean in MailGlue and separate local metrics from pipeline routing

MailGlue initializes FOG during its idle work because it has a pre-init buffer. Current initialization explicitly selects thunderbird.desktop. The first migration used the default identifier and required a later routing fix. Current compose tests initialize FOG after creating a profile and now also explicitly select thunderbird.desktop. The 2024 follow-up review allowed the default ID in unit tests; do not treat that historical test choice as current practice. Metric value tests do not verify pipeline submission routing.

Scope: telemetry-initialization.
